review_candidates.title: Technical Lead - GPU Infrastructure
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Architecture. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.
eligibility_evidence: Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Slurm at scale, hands on.
